verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is an LLM gateway and SDK. A platform like this could plausibly offer user-defined background jobs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows users can create autonomous or scheduled automations. Background traffic mirroring, automatic fallbacks, request queueing and budget resets are built-in gateway behaviors, not automations a user sets up, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
